noProfile.title: You don't have a profile yet
noProfile.body: Ask your agent to build it from your CV (“create my profile from my CV”). If you'd rather start from scratch, the guide explains how.
noProfile.unreadable: Your profile file has an error and can't be read. Ask your agent to fix it (“check and fix my profile”).

issues.title: Your profile has errors. You can fix them here: until then, no block can be saved.

unsaved.confirm: You have unsaved changes in My profile. Leave without saving them?

errors.validation: Some fields need a look: they're marked below.
errors.conflict: Your profile changed since you opened this page (you edited it by hand, or your agent did). Press Reload to see it and make your change again.
errors.partial: Part of this block was saved and part wasn't: your profile has been reloaded. Check the block and save what's missing again.

preview.title: This is how your profile will change
preview.rescore: Saving recalculates the scores of your open jobs.

personal.title: Details and summary
personal.hint: Your name, links and summary go in your CVs. Email and phone only go in the CV you hand in: your agent never sees them.

experience.title: Experience
experience.hint: Each achievement is something a CV can claim: write it as it happened, with the real metric if you have it.

projects.title: Projects
projects.hint: Personal, academic or work projects. With the link to the repository or demo if there is one.

extra.title: Other sections
extra.hint: Volunteering, awards, publications…: they go in the CV exactly as you write them.

skills.title: Skills and languages
skills.hint: Levels are private: they decide what a CV may claim, but never appear in it. Saving recalculates the scores.
skills.levels: F: strong, you use it daily · C+: used in real projects · C: you know it · B: basic, only as "knowledge of".

stories.title: STAR stories
stories.hint: For interviews: situation, task, action and result. Each one cites at least one achievement or project from your profile.
stories.needEvidence: Each story needs at least one piece of evidence before it can be saved.

searchRole.title: Role
searchRole.hint: Which roles and levels you want, and which title words discard a job. When you save you'll see the change, and your open jobs will be rescored.

searchExperience.title: Experience and salary
searchExperience.hint: The years of experience a job asks for and the minimum salary you accept.

searchWhere.title: Where and how
searchWhere.hint: Work mode, locations and the languages you would work in.

searchContract.title: Contract and employer
searchContract.hint: Contract type, working time, type of employer and doubtful jobs. What a job doesn't say never discards it.

cv.title: CV preferences
cv.hint: Template, length, photo and instructions for all your CVs. Instructions for one job are given when you generate it.
cv.rules_one: You have {{count}} template rule (by ATS or country): it's kept. To change it, ask your agent.
cv.rules_other: You have {{count}} template rules (by ATS or country): they're kept. To change them, ask your agent.

letter.title: Cover letter preferences
letter.hint: For all your letters. The instructions for each job are on its page and take precedence.

fields.name: Name
fields.headline: Headline
fields.headlineHint: One line under your name, e.g. "Data Engineer · Python · SQL".
fields.privateContact: Private: only goes in the CV you hand in. Your agent doesn't see it.
fields.contextHint: What it does or which team it was, in one sentence.
fields.achievementHint: What you did and what happened, plainly. Your agent can help you word it better.
fields.metricsHint: Only the real one: "-35% load time". If you don't know it, leave it empty.
fields.sourceHint: A public link that proves it (optional).
fields.skillsHint: Only skills in your profile (with a level or basic): add missing ones first under Skills and languages.
fields.nda: Confidential (NDA): the CV gives no internal details or client
fields.regionalHint: Only if it matters in one region (e.g. Galician in Galicia).
fields.basicSkillsHint: You know them a little: they only appear if the job asks for them, as "knowledge of".
fields.evidenceHint: The achievements or projects in your profile that back this story.
fields.evidenceRequired: Pick at least one piece of evidence.
fields.noEvidence: No achievements or projects to cite yet: add them first under Experience or Projects.
fields.rolesHint: By priority. Anything unlike them scores lower.

locations.allowedHint: Fine if the job is hybrid or remote; if it's on-site, it's discarded.
locations.excludedHint: Always discarded. With no preferred or "only if not on-site" ones, anywhere else is fine.

fields.photoDefault: Include a photo in the CV
fields.photoNoHint: Two-letter codes in capitals: GB, US, IE…
fields.instructionsHint: Emphasis or style. They guide the writing but are never a fact: new information goes in its own section.
fields.avoidHint: Phrases or topics you don't want to see.
fields.maxWordsHint: Between 50 and 600. Empty: the app's default.
fields.letterInstructionsHint: Your motivation, how you got into your field… The letter may quote it as said by you, so write it in your own words.
fields.years: Years of experience the job asks for
fields.yearsHint_one: Empty: no limit. {{count}} year of leeway is allowed on each side.
fields.yearsHint_other: Empty: no limit. {{count}} years of leeway are allowed on each side.
fields.salaryHint: Only the app sees it: your agent never sees this figure. It discards jobs that publish a lower salary (a monthly one counts ×12); if they don't publish one, it doesn't.
fields.salaryInvalid: Enter a whole number of euros above 0, or leave it empty.
fields.salaryLoadError: Your minimum salary couldn't be read: reload the page before changing it.
fields.discardKeywordsHint: If the title contains one (whole word, accents ignored), the job is discarded. Also before saving jobs from your sources.
fields.policyKeywords: The app's settings also rule out: {{words}}.
fields.noneMeansAny: Nothing ticked: any. If the job doesn't say, it isn't discarded.

employer.consultancy: Exclude consultancies (they hire you to place you with a client)

fields.employerKindsHint: Your agent notes it when it extracts each job. If it's unknown, the job isn't discarded.
fields.employerHidden: Discard jobs that don't say which company is hiring (hidden employer, or an agency that doesn't say who for)

situation.label: Situation
situation.hint: The context: where you were and what was going on.

action.label: Action
action.hint: What you did, in the first person.

result.label: Result
result.hint: What happened in the end, with numbers if you have them.

context.emptyPreview: Nothing written yet (the guide comments are not shown here).
context.newFile: doesn't exist yet: it's created when you save

style.title: Writing samples
style.hint: Old letters, emails or posts of yours (.txt, .md, .docx, .pdf). Your agent takes your tone from them, never facts.
style.risk: It contains phrases aimed at an AI ("{{excerpt}}"): your agent will read it as data and won't follow them.

history.title: History
history.hint: Every save keeps a copy of your profile: you can always go back.
history.diffLabel: Changes between the last two versions
history.noDiff: There's only one version: nothing to compare with yet.
history.undone: Done: your profile is back to how it was before the last save.
history.saveFirst: Save or discard the blocks with changes first.
